description: We are a team from Portugal, with interest in space exploration and physics, that was looking for a challenge when we found the NASA SAC. We are very excited to participate and we hope our project is one of the best!
summary: Using Python and Pygame, we developed an app about a futuristic communications mission on a moon base. As the challenge was to design a space mission that would help students understand the complexity of such missions, we decided that a game with modern graphics and an intriguing and challenging storyline would capture their attention.
details:
It is an educational game designed to immerse players in the amazing aerospace world as well as its missions. That is one of the main goals of our project: to generate interest in space exploration and science itself. We are welcoming players into the world of physics, chemistry, maths and even biology!

Alert message: That’s what players receive once they join the game: a base on the Moon needs their help! From that moment on, they have to keep up and build their own mission carefully, taking into account the budget provided and the storage available in their spacecraft. Players will have to plan everything and carefully choose their spacecraft, crew members, equipment and tools, because each decision can have a significant impact on the future of the mission.

Furthermore, there’s always a chance for things to go wrong, even if they choose the most suitable option, in order to make this immersive experience reflect the reality of aerospace missions. That’s how we transform simple facts about space missions into an interactive experience for players to learn about them.

As an educational game, there’s the possibility to point out its benefits. This project is not only for people who already have knowledge of this subject; it is also a useful tool to teach beginners about space missions and all their processes: before, during and even after.

It encourages curiosity, critical thinking, problem-solving and decision-making, since, as the experience starts, players will be constantly facing challenges.

The process of developing this project involved two essential things: a united group of friends with a big passion and technology to turn dreams into reality.

First of all, we highlight the tools that we have used: Visual Studio Code, Figma and Claude, an AI assistant. That’s how we could interlink the scientific world with new-generation technologies, such as AI.

The programming language that we have used is Python, because of its practical use and the team members' knowledge of it.

To cut a long story short, throughout the development of our project, we considered several important factors to ensure that our game would be both educational and enjoyable. This is an inclusive game: both beginners and experienced people are able to play and enjoy it.

Moreover, we have been concerned about its educational value, as we have already mentioned earlier.

To finish, we want to point out that, as a team, we are proud of the result of our project. In spite of the hard work and, of course, the difficulties that we have faced in the process, our friendship has been strengthened. We are proud to present ourselves as a team.
